info.name: FitWise API — Assignment 4
info.description:
Complete FitWise API collection for Assignment 4.

All responses follow the envelope:
  SUCCESS: { "success": true,  "data": <any>,  "error": null }
  ERROR:   { "success": false, "data": null,   "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "details": {} } }

Seeded accounts (all passwords: password123):
  john@fitwize.com   id=1  role=user
  noam@fitwize.com   id=2  role=user
  dana@fitwize.com   id=3  role=user
  roi@fitwize.com    id=4  role=admin
  maya@fitwize.com   id=5  role=manager
  eitan@fitwize.com  id=6  role=user

Required headers for most requests:
  userid       : numeric user id
  x-user-id    : numeric user id (alias used by some routes)
  x-user-role  : user | admin | manager

Update collection variables with real IDs after running Create requests.

variable.description: Update after Get All Workout Plans
Update after Get All Daily Meal Plans

item.name: 01 - Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints. No auth headers required.

request.description:
Returns userId, firstName, lastName, userRole, email.
Copy the returned userId into the user_id collection variable.
Login as admin. Use returned userId as admin_id variable.

Creates account, profile, settings, support conversation, and AI-generated workout + meal plans via Gemini.
Returns 201 with userId and caloricTarget.

gender: male | female
activityLevel: beginner | intermediate | advanced
fitnessGoal: weight_loss | muscle_gain | maintenance
Demonstrates EMAIL_TAKEN error (409). john@fitwize.com is already seeded.
Server-side no-op. Client clears localStorage.

item.name: 02 - Users
item.description: User management. GET all/by-id requires admin or manager. POST/PUT/DELETE requires admin.

request.description: Returns the current user's data from x-user-id header. Password field is omitted.

Creates a user record (no profile/plans generated). For full registration with AI plans use POST /api/auth/register.
userRole: user | admin | manager
gender: male | female
activityLevel: beginner | intermediate | advanced
Replace 7 with the id of a user created via Create User. Do not delete seeded accounts.

item.description: Exercise library. Read: any role. Create/Update: admin or manager. Delete: admin only.

item.name: 04 - Food Items
item.description: Food database. Read: any role. Create/Update: admin or manager. Delete: admin only.

query.description: Portion size in grams for the original food item

request.description:
Returns food items in the same category that provide the same calories as <grams>g of the original item.
Only returns items where the equivalent portion is between 50g and 500g.
All numeric fields must be non-negative numbers.
Admin only. Use an item not referenced in existing meal plans.

item.name: 05 - Workout Plans
item.description: User workout plans. GET /:id returns the full relational JOIN: Plan → Days → Exercises (Many-to-Many proof).

request.description: Returns only is_active=true plans for the requesting user. One-to-Many: User → WorkoutPlans.

item.name: Get Workout Plan By ID – JOIN Proof

request.description:
Creates an empty plan (no days/exercises). AI-generated plans have days and exercises pre-populated.
goal: weight_loss | muscle_gain | maintenance
isActive must be a boolean.
Returns { "workoutPlanId": N }. Cascades to WorkoutPlanDays and PlanExercises.

item.name: 06 - Workout Logs
item.description: Logged workout sessions. POST body includes exercises[] with sets[] proving Many-to-Many: Exercise ↔ WorkoutLog via LogExercise.

request.description: Optional query params: ?workoutPlanId=N and/or ?workoutDayId=N to filter.
Returns the log with nested exercises[] and sets[].

Validates: workoutPlanId > 0, durationMinutes > 0, difficultyRating 1–10, exercises is non-empty array, each exercise has exerciseId + exerciseName + non-empty sets[], each set has setNumber > 0, reps >= 0, weight >= 0.
Deletes existing exercises/sets for this log and replaces them with the new exercises array.
Returns { "workoutLogId": N }.

item.name: 07 - Daily Meal Plans
item.description: User meal plans with nested meals and food items. POST/PUT prove Many-to-Many: FoodItem ↔ Meal via MealFoodItem (meal_entries).

item.name: Get Daily Meal Plan By ID – JOIN Proof

request.description:
Returns DailyMealPlan → Meals → MealFoodItems join.
Proves Many-to-Many: Meal ↔ FoodItem via meal_entries junction table.

mealType: breakfast | lunch | dinner | snack
targetCalories and targetProtein must be positive numbers.
foodItemId must reference an existing food item in the database.
Update foodItemIds to match your seeded food items.
Replaces all existing meals (delete-then-insert). Must include all meals in the update.
Returns { "dailyMealPlanId": N }. Cascades to Meals and MealFoodItems.

item.name: 08 - Check-Ins
item.description: Weekly weigh-in records. Creating a check-in automatically updates profile.currentWeight to the latest value.

request.description:
weight must be a positive number.
workoutsCompleted must be a non-negative number.
feedback is optional.
Creating a check-in triggers profile.currentWeight sync.
Returns { "checkInId": N }. Profile weight re-syncs to next most-recent check-in.

Missing required fields. Expected:
{ "success": false, "data": null, "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "Missing required check-in fields", "details": { "missingFields": ["weight", "workoutsCompleted"] } } }

item.name: 09 - Profiles
item.description: User fitness profiles. Replan triggers AI to regenerate workout and meal plans.

request.description:
Creates a profile for the user identified by the userid header.
UserId comes from the userid header, NOT the URL.
failure if profile already exists for this user.
All fields are optional. Only provided fields are updated.

Deactivates current plans, calls Gemini to generate new workout + meal plans, and resets today's progress calories.
Required: fitnessGoal, activityLevel, workoutsPerWeek, mealsPerDay
Optional: height, currentWeight

item.name: 10 - Settings
item.description: User display settings. userId from x-user-id header (not URL). Settings auto-created on registration.

request.description: Note: userId comes from x-user-id header, NOT the URL path.

All three fields are required: displayName, email, theme.
theme: light | dark

item.name: 11 - Progress
item.description: Daily aggregated metrics. Composite unique constraint: (user_id, date) — one record per user per day.

request.description: Date format: YYYY-MM-DD

All numeric values must be non-negative.
Use a date that does not already have a record (unique per user+date).
The app internally updates today's progress when meals are logged.
Route uses numeric id (:id), not date. Set progress_id variable after Create Progress.

item.name: 12 - AI
item.description: Three AI integration points using Google Gemini 2.5 Flash. API key is server-side only.

request.description:
Collects profile, check-in history, workout logs, and active plans then calls Gemini.
Returns 201 with:
  weightAssessment, nutritionAssessment, workoutAssessment (strings)
  recommendations[] (type, priority, change, reason)
  actionsApplied.caloricTargetAdjustment (applied to profile + meal plan)
  actionsApplied.exerciseAdjustmentsCount (applied to plan exercises)

Requires at least 1 check-in for meaningful analysis. Run Create Check-In first.
Returns stored AI recommendations from the ai_recommendations table. Empty array if no analysis has been run yet.

Stateless HTTP chat endpoint (not WebSocket). Each request is independent.
The FitWise AI Coach is instructed to give 2–4 sentence fitness-focused responses.
Returns: { "success": true, "data": { "message": "...", "timestamp": "..." }, "error": null }

Note: This is separate from the support chat (WebSocket). The AI chat widget in the frontend uses this endpoint.
Expected: { "success": false, "data": null, "error": { "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR", "message": "message is required", "details": {} } }

item.name: 13 - Support (WebSocket HTTP API)
item.description:
HTTP endpoints backing the Socket.IO support chat.

The real-time part uses Socket.IO on /support namespace with events:
  Client→Server: support:join, support:message, support:typing
  Server→Client: support:joined, support:new_message, support:presence_update, support:error

These HTTP endpoints read/write the same data that Socket.IO populates.

request.description:
Returns the logged-in user's support conversation and all messages.
If no conversation exists yet, auto-creates one and returns { id: null, userId, messages: [] }.
Messages are persisted from Socket.IO support:message events.

Returns online/offline status for all admins and managers.
The isOnline field reflects live in-memory Socket.IO socket state (not just DB value).
This proves Socket.IO presence data is accessible via REST.

Admin/manager only. Returns all user conversations with presence data (isOnline, lastSeen).
Used by AdminPage Chat Center to list users who have sent support messages.

item.name: Get User Conversation By User ID (Admin)

request.description:
Admin/manager only. Returns the full conversation for a specific user including all messages.
Creates the conversation if it does not exist yet.

item.name: 14 - Admin
item.description: Admin-only aggregate views. Require x-user-role: admin or manager.

request.description: Returns workout plans for ALL users. Admin Panel aggregate view.

item.name: Get All Daily Meal Plans (All Users)

request.description: Returns meal plans for ALL users. Admin Panel aggregate view.

Returns all users with their currentWeight (from profile) and checkInCount.
Uses Prisma include with _count to perform the relational query in a single DB call.
Returns the full check-in history for a specific user. Used in AdminPage to view user weight trend.

Demonstrates FORBIDDEN error when a regular user accesses an admin endpoint.
Expected: { "success": false, "data": null, "error": { "code": "FORBIDDEN", "message": "Admin or manager access required", "details": {} } }
